regional_reference: Treat Transnistria as Moldova-first for registered veterinary medicines, then verify exact local product availability and packaging before any real-world use.

sources.title: ANSA Moldova State Register of Veterinary Medicinal Products
sources.dosage_use: Use to verify registration status, target species, active substance, release mode, withdrawal period, and Moldova market relevance. Do not treat it as a dosing formulary unless the product page contains official administration details.

sources.title: EU Veterinary Medicines Information / Union Product Database
sources.dosage_use: Use product information/SPC for route, dosage, contraindications, interactions, withdrawal periods, and product availability when the exact product is EU/EMA-authorised or cross-registered.

sources.title: EMA Veterinary EPAR/Product Information
sources.dosage_use: Use when a Moldova/ANSA item references EMA or when the exact product is centrally authorised.

sources.title: Plumb's Veterinary Drugs
sources.license_status: subscription required; do not ingest without project-owner license
sources.dosage_use: Preferred practical formulary for small-animal dosing once licensed. Store only user-owned notes/excerpts permitted by the license.

sources.title: BSAVA Small Animal Formulary
sources.license_status: subscription or purchase required; do not ingest without project-owner license
sources.dosage_use: Preferred dog/cat and exotics formulary once licensed, especially for study use and cross-checking.

sources.title: MSD/Merck Veterinary Manual
sources.license_status: public manual; respect terms and avoid bulk copying
sources.dosage_use: Use for disease background, pharmacology context, toxicology and clinical reasoning. Do not use as the sole source for product-specific dosing when an official label/SPC is required.

sources.title: ESCCAP Guidelines
sources.license_status: public guidelines; cite and avoid wholesale copying
sources.dosage_use: Use for parasite prevention/treatment strategy and regional risk framing; verify exact product and dose by label/formulary.

sources.title: WSAVA Global Guidelines
sources.license_status: public guidelines; cite and avoid wholesale copying
sources.dosage_use: Use for broad clinical guidance, vaccination/nutrition/pain context where relevant; verify exact drug dose elsewhere.
